hero.title: Where Iraqi enterprise meets British business
hero.sentence: A member-based council building trade, investment and lasting partnerships between Iraq and the United Kingdom.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: The Iraqi–British Business Council brings Iraqi and British companies together. We open doors to partners, investors and markets in both countries, and give our members a trusted voice with official standing between the two economies.

visionMission.title: Vision and mission
visionMission.vision: To be the leading bridge for trade and investment between Iraq and the United Kingdom.
visionMission.mission: To connect Iraqi and British companies and help them grow, through introductions, access to markets and practical support.

heading.title: About the council
heading.lede: Who the council is, the official standing it was formed with, and what it works to achieve.

who.title: Who we are
who.p1: The Iraqi–British Business Council is a member-based council that connects Iraqi and British companies. It works for businesses on both sides: Iraqi firms looking for partners, expertise and markets in the United Kingdom, and British firms looking at the opportunities Iraq offers.
who.p2: Because the council was formed in Iraq, its work starts from close knowledge of the Iraqi market: how business is done there, where growth is coming from and what a partner from abroad needs to know before committing.
who.p3: Membership gives a company its place in that network: introductions to the right counterparts, a clearer view of each market, and a council that raises the issues that matter to its members with the bodies concerned.

standing.title: Official standing
standing.body: This standing is the basis of the council's work: companies in both countries deal with a body established within Iraq's own institutions.

objectives.title: Our objectives
objectives.lede: The six areas of work through which the council serves its members.

heading.title: Membership
heading.lede: Why companies join the council, what membership offers, and how to apply.

whyJoin.title: Why join
whyJoin.intro: Membership places your company in a network of Iraqi and British businesses, close to the institutions that shape trade between the two countries, alongside a council that knows the Iraqi market from within. Whether you are an Iraqi firm looking to grow abroad or a British firm looking at Iraq, the council works to turn that interest into partnerships.

benefits.title: Membership benefits
benefits.lede: What membership gives every company in the council's network.

tiers.title: Membership tiers
tiers.lede: Three tiers, each building on the one before. Choose the one that suits your company and apply; the council will discuss the terms of membership with you after your application.
